title: Using Innovative Securities under Asymmetric Information: Why Do Some Firms Pay with Contingent Value Rights?

rival_explanations: The positive announcement effect is driven by cash accompanying the CVR rather than by the CVR itself
The results are driven by the signaling role of the cash bundled in the CVR payment rather than by the CVR itself

context.industry_setting: cross-industry (M&A firms across sectors; control sample drawn to match the SIC industries of the CVR-offering firms, industries defined by the first two digits of SIC codes)
context.country_region: United States (CVR-offering firms listed on U.S. exchanges)
context.sample_size: CVR sample: 29 announcements; control sample: 1,008 takeovers and 261 partial acquisitions
